query:
INSERT INTO perique_molecule_links (perique_compound_id, molecule_id, match_type, confidence, notes)
SELECT pc.id, m.id, 'exact_name', 1.00, CONCAT('Liaison automatique: ', pc.name)
FROM perique_compounds pc
JOIN molecules m ON LOWER(pc.name) = LOWER(m.name)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
